title: Cho tôi hóa đơn: asking for the bill

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say you, for an older man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: anh] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say you, for an older woman —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chị] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say you, for someone younger —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: em] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say more, or add —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thêm] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say a little, or less —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ít] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say ice —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đá] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Anh ơi, cho tôi hóa đơn.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Dạ.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn anh.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: You said] [VI: cho tôi] [EN: it means give me.
